items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, he was? So it was Jimmy Jones and John Levy and Sid -- [INTERVIEWEE] Sid and Stuff Smith.

ctx.x: Oh, he was? So it was Jimmy Jones and John Levy and Sid --
Oh, is that right? That was before he and Jonah and Cozy went into the Famous Door, I guess. Because you said the Onyx Club, didn't you?
